description: Phase 6 agent golden set — exact tool trajectories of the deterministic mock policy over the shared eval catalog (18 items, no bags, one weather-mismatched shoe s3). Under --provider mock these trajectories are FIXED; under the LLM decision layer the same cases run but the trajectory assertion is relaxed.

cases.query: I need a black turtleneck with jeans for winter
cases.note: Happy path: search → compose → validate → finish success. Weather/prefs never warranted.

cases.query: what should I wear today — is it cold outside?
cases.note: Weather-dependent request: get_weather is called BEFORE any search.

cases.query: an outfit for me with a top and jeans
cases.note: Personalized request: get_user_preferences is called FIRST.

cases.query: give me a black summer outfit
cases.note: Black+summer admits t5/b4/s3; the weather guard rejects s3 (canvas sneakers tagged cool/mild). One retry with the SAME hard set, then finish no-valid. Hard constraints are NEVER relaxed between searches.

cases.query: 一个精致的黑色手提包
cases.note: The catalog has NO bags. Zero candidates; one retry with the frozen hard set, then finish unsatisfiable.

cases.query: a crew neck tee with jeans
cases.note: A ghost vector identical to t1 ranks at the top. It must never surface in candidates, the look, or the final items.
